from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def model(p, mode):
    w=p[0]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    base=p[1]+p[2]*x+p[3]*v+p[4]*v**2+(p[5]+p[6]*v)*C+(p[7]+p[8]*v)*S
    if mode==1: base=base*np.exp(-p[9]*t)
    if mode==2: base=base+p[9]*x*v+p[10]*x**2
    if mode==3: base=base+p[9]*t
    return base
